name: Chromatix-PM
author: SpectrumMCPE
description: Chromatix-PM Minecraft Bedrock server for Pterodactyl.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq wget
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
wget -O chromatix.jar https://github.com/SpectrumMCPE/Chromatix-MP/releases/download/nightly/chromatix.jar
cat > start.sh <<'START_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
exec java -Xms128M -Xmx${SERVER_MEMORY}M -jar chromatix.jar --skip-setup --accept-license --language eng
START_SCRIPT
chmod +x start.sh
